name: Durable condition checkpoints real-frame process-interruption gate v1
design: Two independent processes on the same four real targets: uninterrupted reference and SIGKILL during local after a saved partial target; resume in a third process. Require exact frame records and raw attention calls for all three arms, native parity, unchanged parameters/temporal slots, preserved partial folder, and matching cross-frame audit. This tests actual condition runner and checkpoint helpers; durable cohort main resume orchestration remains covered only by mocked integration and needs separate real-run validation. No efficacy inference.
